edge_explainer: TAPE: the drawdown premise is contaminated. The 8-K of 05-12 states when-issued US trading began 05-21 and REGULAR-WAY began 2026-05-28; distribution was effective 05-22 at 7:30am NY, ratio 1 Octave share per 10 Hexagon shares, class for class. The 05-21 bar that produced the $30.00 quote-feed 52-week high traded 6,695 SHARES. Clean baseline is $17.48 (05-28 close), from which the stock is +9.4%, not -16.9%. True regular-way drawdown from the $25.11 high (06-02) to the $15.50 low (07-23) was -38.3%, WORSE than the generator's -29.4%; it is now +23.4% off that low in 8 sessions, which is a LATE bounce. 73 days out; window closes ~08-20. Today's +4.88% on 2,189,923 shares (heaviest since 06-02) has NO identified cause — EDGAR (newest filing of any kind is the S-8 of 07-23), the IR newsroom (newest item 07-15), analyst actions and index channels were all checked and are clean. Recorded as UNVERIFIED, not as 'no news'. FLOW: this is the real orphan. OCTV was CONFIRMED ABSENT from the June 2026 Russell reconstitution — the official FTSE Russell additions and deletions PDFs (effective 06-26) were downloaded and text-searched with zero hits — and the mechanism is methodology v7.1 section 6.4.1: rank day was 2026-04-30, three weeks before the 05-22 spin, and ineligible non-members are not reevaluated for later corporate actions. Hexagon retained NOTHING (10-Q Note 14). So Hexagon holders received a line no US index fund holds, with no in-kind mechanical buyer anywhere and no offsetting bid. The offsetting supply is the control block: Melker Schorling AB and the Schorling family (SC 13D 06-01) hold 58,433,144 shares = 21.8% of economics and 42.9% of total voting power, filed on 13D not 13G, with a full Item 4 reservation of rights and NO STANDSTILL AND NO LOCK-UP — registration rights open 2027-05-22 but open-market sales are available today. CAP STRUCTURE, worse than guided: term loan ($350M USD + EUR150M) FULLY drawn PLUS revolver drawn $120M + EUR25M = ~$674M gross vs the ~$525M pro forma, and $625M actually paid to Hexagon vs $598.2M estimated. Net debt ~$594M vs the '~$445M' figure. 268,437,788 shares (11,025,000 Class A at 10 votes, unlisted, 100% held by MSAB; 257,412,788 Class B at 1 vote, the Nasdaq line — a US buyer owns the actual Class B ordinary shares, not a depositary line; the SDR structure sits on the Stockholm side only). S-8 of 07-23 registers 20,992,537 shares = 7.8% dilution. THE DECISIVE FINDING: the reported +1.0% Q1 revenue growth is ENTIRELY CURRENCY. The 10-Q's own constant-currency table shows $371,962k vs $382,804k = -2.83% ORGANIC, on a +$14,539k FX tailwind. Subscriptions +3.8% cc (not +7.9%), licenses -20.7% cc, services -14.6% cc, and the United States — the largest single geography — fell 9.1%. Standing guidance (Form 10 MD&A pp.90-91 and Investor Day 03-26 slide 110, never updated or reaffirmed since) is 3-4% growth for FY26, so the guide now needs roughly +6 to +7% in H2 off a negative Q1. The datum is honestly disclosed inside a constant-currency table; the marketed takeaway ('a misunderstood spin-off at a deep discount', Seeking Alpha 06-19) has not moved. Second, same direction: FY25 GAAP EBIT of $336.9M is FLATTERED by a $(54,950)k credit — 'Acquisition costs and charges' is negative in the FY25 bridge, a contingent-consideration remeasurement gain. Third: gross recurring dis-synergy is ~$47M, presented as a net $(7.8)M only by offsetting $39.2M of restructuring synergies already actioned in 2025. GOVERNANCE: two UNREMEDIATED material weaknesses as of 12/31/25 — segregation of duties over manual journal entries, and IT general controls — with the auditor changed at separation (PwC Sweden dismissed 05-20, PwC US appointed), in a company about to run its first standalone close. VALUATION: 268.44M x $19.13 = $5.135B cap, EV ~$5.73B; FY25 revenue $1,637.9M -> 3.50x sales; FY25 adjusted income from operations $506.3M (31%) -> 11.3x, a genuine discount to infrastructure-software peers; pro forma FY25 EPS $0.87 -> 22.0x; ~5.7% levered FCF yield. The discount is real. The question is whether a business printing -2.8% organic deserves the peer multiple, and our answer is not yet — E[FV] $19.59 against $19.13. NOTE: Octave does NOT report Adjusted EBITDA; no EBITDA figure should ever be cited for this name. DOCTRINE CONFIRMED: no quiet period — twelve firms cover it (confirmed from Octave's own IR page) and every disclosed rating is neutral-equivalent (Goldman Neutral 06-01, RBC Sector Perform 06-02, Evercore In Line 06-12, Barclays Equalweight PT $18 06-18, RBC Hold PT $21 07-17). Not one buy located.
